root_idea.summary: The root centers on obedience to God expressed with submission, humility, and religious devotion.
root_idea.development: The basic sense of obedience develops into steadfast religious observance, prayerful standing, attentive silence, and worshipful service. Related Classical Arabic branches extend to humility, tractability, and certain specialized uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed under the standard masculine active-participle citation form.
The Quran-only feminine plural active participle is an inflectional variant of قَانِتٌ and is represented under the singular citation form.

senses.definition: To obey God and remain devoutly submissive to Him.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction commonly takes لِـ with God; direct-object usage is reported as unusual. The sense includes steadfast adherence to obedience.

senses.definition: Obedient to God with humility and submission; steadfast in religious obedience.
senses.usage_conditions: For created beings, the Quranic usage can denote subjection to God's creative will rather than voluntary religious observance. The masculine and feminine forms share this lexical sense.

senses.definition: Devotedly engaged in worship, especially prayerful devotion.
senses.usage_conditions: In prayer-related usage, the devotion may include attentive stillness and abstention from ordinary human speech; Quranic discussion also presents the worshipper in standing and prostration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Standing, especially prolonged standing, in the performance of prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also refer to the standing posture associated with the qunut prayer practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Supplication to God, especially the qunut supplication recited while standing in prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the conventional ritual use of دُعَاءُ القُنُوتِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The prescribed act of prayer itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a synonym for صَلَاةٌ in the reported Classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Continuing the performance of the pilgrimage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal-noun usage describing continuation of the pilgrimage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prolonging engagement in warfare, including warfare accompanied by plundering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage applied to the continuation of fighting or raiding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Confessing or acknowledging one's condition as a servant of God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This denotes recognition of servanthood rather than merely the general performance of obedience.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be lowly, humble, or submissive to another; of a woman, to be quiet, submissive, and obedient to her husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a broader interpersonal humility and submissiveness usage, distinct from Quranic religious obedience to God.
A distinct lexical branch associated with the noun قَنُتَ.
A Form IV usage with an enemy as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower, humble, or submit oneself to God.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII usage describing a change into a tractable or submissive state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who is lowly, humble, submissive, and obedient to her husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical noun describing a woman; this specialized interpersonal sense is not generalized to Quranic religious obedience.
A distinct adjective or noun with a specialized description of a woman's eating little.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skin or leather container that retains water and does not exude.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description of a watertight skin container.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Obedience and the distinction between religious obedience and subjection to divine will are covered by the Quranic senses.
Standing and prolonged standing in prayer are represented.
Supplication, especially the standing prayer supplication, is represented.
The synonymic prayer usage is represented.
Prayerful silence and withholding ordinary speech are covered by the worship-and-prayer sense.
Service of God is covered by devoted worship.
Continuation of pilgrimage is represented as a Classical specialization.
Prolonged warfare or raiding is represented.
Acknowledged servant status is represented separately from obedience.
General interpersonal humility and submissiveness, including the woman-husband construction, are represented.
The distinct eating-little noun is represented.
The Form IV standing-in-prayer usage is covered by the represented standing meaning.
The Form IV enemy-cursing usage is represented.
Pointer-only cross-reference.
The Form IV self-humbling-to-God usage is represented.
The Form VIII becoming tractable or submissive is represented.
The specialized noun for a submissive and obedient woman is represented.
The قَنِيتٌ description of a woman who eats little is represented.
The technical watertight-skin usage is represented.
Pointer and inflectional description of قَانِتٌ; it adds no independent lexical branch.
